description.value: Soft Peaks Ice Cream is an artisanal soft-serve counter near Metrotown in Burnaby, distinguished by monthly rotating flavors such as the earthy matcha 'Green Forest' and seasonal offerings like festive eggnog. Beyond ice cream, the shop serves a full espresso and tea menu in a bright, airy space with distinctive wooden step seating. It offers a calm, welcoming rest stop for cyclists looking for a sweet treat and coffee in the Metrotown area.
